title: My Capricorn friend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuuya Matsuda has stayed silent while his classmate Naoto Wakatsuki is bullied. After finding a newspaper that seems to come from the future, he meets Naoto fleeing the scene of the bully's killing, and out of guilt helps him hide and then run. A one-volume story by Otsuichi in which the truth turns out more complicated than it first seems.
life_message: Looking away from someone's suffering has a cost; standing beside a friend, even late, matters.
